ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram labeled “Food Web”. The diagram includes animals such as Rabbit, Snake, and Hawk, and uses arrows to indicate food relationships; the direction of the arrows is from the organism being eaten to the animal that eats it. It can be seen that one arrow points from Rabbit to Hawk, and another arrow points from Snake to Hawk. Reasoning: The question asks which animal eats both rabbits and snakes. Because Hawk receives arrows from both Rabbit and Snake, the animal that eats both rabbits and snakes is hawk.
